channel.title: Teotihuacan: City of the Gods
channel.description: Step into one of the ancient world’s greatest cities. This private walking audio tour explores Teotihuacan’s monumental architecture, sacred landscapes, daily life, rise, and collapse — from the Pyramid of the Sun and Avenue of the Dead to the Pyramid of the Moon and Quetzalpapálotl Complex.
channel.itunes:author: Mauricio Jean
channel.itunes:summary: Step into one of the ancient world’s greatest cities with this private walking audio tour of Teotihuacan.

item.title: Prologue — Approaching Teotihuacan
item.description: Begin the tour with an immersive approach to Teotihuacan, setting the scene before entering the ancient city.
item.itunes:summary: Begin the tour with an immersive approach to Teotihuacan, setting the scene before entering the ancient city.

item.title: Teotihuacan — City of the Gods
item.description: An introduction to Teotihuacan: its scale, people, monumental landscape, and place in the ancient world.
item.itunes:summary: An introduction to Teotihuacan: its scale, people, monumental landscape, and place in the ancient world.

item.title: Pyramid of the Sun
item.description: Explore Teotihuacan’s largest pyramid, its construction, sacred landscape, and the mysteries beneath the monument.
item.itunes:summary: Explore Teotihuacan’s largest pyramid, its construction, sacred landscape, and the mysteries beneath the monument.

item.title: The Avenue of the Dead & the City’s Master Plan
item.description: Walk through the city’s monumental axis and discover the planning, alignments, architecture, and organization behind Teotihuacan.
item.itunes:summary: Walk through the city’s monumental axis and discover the planning, alignments, architecture, and organization behind Teotihuacan.

item.title: The Ciudadela & Feathered Serpent Pyramid
item.description: Discover the Ciudadela and the Temple of the Feathered Serpent, including its architecture, symbolism, and archaeological evidence.
item.itunes:summary: Discover the Ciudadela and the Temple of the Feathered Serpent, including its architecture, symbolism, and archaeological evidence.

item.title: The Community — Life in Teotihuacan
item.description: Step beyond the monuments to explore apartment compounds, neighborhoods, trade, craft production, and everyday life in the city.
item.itunes:summary: Step beyond the monuments to explore apartment compounds, neighborhoods, trade, craft production, and everyday life in the city.

item.title: Plaza & Pyramid of the Moon
item.description: Explore the northern ceremonial heart of Teotihuacan, the Plaza of the Moon, and the pyramid’s long sequence of construction.
item.itunes:summary: Explore the northern ceremonial heart of Teotihuacan, the Plaza of the Moon, and the pyramid’s long sequence of construction.

item.title: The Quetzalpapálotl Complex
item.description: Explore the richly decorated Quetzalpapálotl complex and what its architecture, murals, and courtyards reveal about elite ceremonial life.
item.itunes:summary: Explore the richly decorated Quetzalpapálotl complex and what its architecture, murals, and courtyards reveal about elite ceremonial life.

item.title: The Collapse of Teotihuacan
item.description: Examine the evidence surrounding Teotihuacan’s decline, internal conflict, burning, abandonment, and the city’s enduring legacy.
item.itunes:summary: Examine the evidence surrounding Teotihuacan’s decline, internal conflict, burning, abandonment, and the city’s enduring legacy.

item.title: Final Conclusion
item.description: Close the walking tour by looking back across Teotihuacan’s monuments, people, mysteries, and influence on later Mesoamerica.
item.itunes:summary: Close the walking tour by looking back across Teotihuacan’s monuments, people, mysteries, and influence on later Mesoamerica.
